text.description_html:
Thrubolt Mounting Kit with Decorative Washer for Glass Door, DWD-TBDEC-GLASS

Kit includes (2) each decorative mounting bolt, (4) plastic washers and (2) bolt protective sleeve for thrubolt mounting one pull to one side of a 1/2" - 3/8" thick glass door. Requires minimum 3/8" diameter hole in glass. (4) 1" outer diameter plastic washers and (2) 3/8" outer diameter plastic tubing.

For use with 409 Series Door Pulls.

Specifications: of Glass Door Mounting Kit

  • Plastic Washers: 1-3/16" OD x 5/16" ID
  • Plastic Tubing: 1/2" OD x 3/8" ID

Sold as a set for One (1) single door pull.
